# RezzCraft

> RezzCraft is a free, cozy, semi-vanilla Minecraft survival server for Java and Bedrock players, who share the same world. Claim land, build a home, trade with neighbors and climb ranks earned by playing. Never pay-to-win.

## How to join

- Server address: mc.rezzcraft.us (Java and Bedrock)
- Bedrock (phone, Windows, console): same address, port 19132. On Xbox, PlayStation and Switch, adding your own servers takes a few extra steps; the Discord helps.
- Use the latest version of Minecraft Java or Bedrock. No mods needed.
- Step-by-step guide: https://www.rezzcraft.us/play.html

## What players get

- Land claims: claimed builds cannot be broken, opened or taken by others.
- A player economy: sell to the server, chest shops, an auction house, buy orders and player contracts.
- Nine ranks plus prestige, all earned with in-game money and time played: https://www.rezzcraft.us/ranks.html
- Crates and daily rewards for voting, daily logins and the starter checklist: https://www.rezzcraft.us/vote.html
- Player-built portal gates, skills, custom fishing and fishing contests.
- Five worlds: main world (with nether and End), a resource world, a creative world and a hardcore world.
- PvP is off in the main world, nether and End; it is on in the arena, duels, the resource world and the hardcore world.
- Rezz, an AI helper bot, answers questions in game chat; staff and regulars help too.
- A 3D live map of the server: https://www.rezzcraft.us/map.html

## Rules (short version)

Be respectful; no politics or controversial topics; no hacking; no griefing, base camping or forced PvP; don't abuse bugs. Full rules: https://www.rezzcraft.us/rules.html

## Store

Optional. It sells cosmetics and convenience perks only, never gear, game money or claim blocks: https://rezzcraft.buycraft.net/

## Bounty Board

At spawn, about 50 blocks west of /spawn (-73 67 84), or type /bounties anywhere: daily quests, rotating bounties, Rare Bounties, questlines and Head Hunts. Rewards include 8 trophies, 9 titles and the Golden Balloon, all earned and never sold. Page: https://www.rezzcraft.us/bounty-board.html

## Help and community

- Discord (200+ members): https://discord.gg/ZhuBYvDWTC
- Support tickets: https://www.rezzcraft.us/support.html, /ticket in game, or support@rezzcraft.us
- Content creators: https://www.rezzcraft.us/creators.html
